comment:
* Version code constants for Android releases. * *

Note: The constants are "public static final int" and are intended for use with annotations * so must stay compile-time resolvable and inline-able. They must match the values from * framework's android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES class. * *

Only historically fixed API levels should be included or abstract concepts like "CURRENT" * should be added. Do not predict API levels. * * {@hide}

variables.name: CUR_DEVELOPMENT
variables.comment:
* The version code for current development build, which has not yet turned into an official
     * release.

variables.name: O
variables.comment: * The version code for Android Oreo (API version 26).

variables.name: P
variables.comment: * The version code for Android Pie (API version 28).

variables.name: Q
variables.comment: * The version code for Android Q (API version 29).

variables.name: R
variables.comment: * The version code for Android R (API version 30).

variables.name: S
variables.comment: * The version code for Android S (API version 31).

variables.name: S_V2
variables.comment: * The version code for Android Sv2 (API version 32).

variables.name: TIRAMISU
variables.comment: * The version code for Android T (API version 33).
